event_description: Executive Order 20-09, extending the COVID-19 state of emergency of Executive Order 20-02 to June 15, 2020; in force during the May 3 to 4, 2020 severe storms, tornadoes, straight-line winds and flooding, for which the year index lists no order, so it matches DR-4552 only by date

COVID-19 state of emergency of Executive Order 20-02, extended by Executive Order 21-07 (March 26, 2021) to August 31, 2021, as the Missouri Register of June 15, 2021 lists it; in force during the June 24 to July 1, 2021 severe storms, tornadoes and flooding, for which the year index lists no order, so it matches DR-4612 only by date

COVID-19 state of emergency of Executive Order 21-09 (August 27, 2021), which the Governor's release of December 30, 2021 says will expire on December 31, 2021; in force during the December 10, 2021 tornadoes and severe storms, for which the year index lists no order, so it matches DR-4636 only by date
